question_text: Construct Python function outcomes(box). box is a permutation of integers 0–9. For each child 0–9, start at that child’s index. Look up box[index]; if it equals the child, record success and stop that child’s search. Otherwise use the value as the next index. Allow at most five lookups per child. Return a ten-element Boolean list of results.
adaptation_rationale: Convert array/pseudocode traversal to Python; supplied permutation avoids imposing a random-library requirement. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
